title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.12799v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning is now the mainstream paradigm for training LLMs on agentic tasks, yet standard practice keeps only the best-validation checkpoint and discards the rest. We show that this is lossy: in GRPO training of LLM agents, the best-validation checkpoint fails on problems that earlier checkpoints from the same run had already solved, and the union of problems solved across checkpoints far exceeds any single one. The discarded checkpoints thus form a teacher pool obtained at no additional training cost, which on-policy distillation (OPD) can mine to recover the lost coverage. Mining this pool raises two challenges: i) which checkpoint to distill from, as no checkpoint dominates the others and complementarity to the student is problem-specific; ii) where to trust it, as even a well-chosen teacher is only locally superior, so indiscriminate distillation overwrites behavior the student has already mastered. We propose

translated_title: Agentic-OPD：通过在线策略蒸馏恢复智能体任务中被遗忘的智能体能力
translated_abstract: 强化学习目前是训练大语言模型执行智能体任务的主流范式，但标准做法只保留验证集表现最佳的检查点，而丢弃其余的检查点。我们证明这种做法是有损失的：在大语言模型智能体的GRPO训练中，验证集最佳的检查点会在同一训练过程中早期检查点已经解决的问题上失败，且所有检查点所解决问题的并集远超任何单个检查点所解决的。因此，这些被丢弃的检查点构成了一个无需额外训练成本即可获得的教师池，在线策略蒸馏（OPD）可以从中挖掘以恢复丢失的覆盖能力。挖掘这一教师池带来两个挑战：其一，应从哪个检查点蒸馏，因为没有哪个检查点能全面优于其他检查点，且其与学生模型的互补性因具体问题而异；其二，应在何处信任它，因为即使是精心挑选的教师模型也只是局部更优，不加区分的蒸馏会覆盖学生模型已经掌握的行为。我们提出……
tldr: 该论文提出Agentic-OPD方法，将GRPO训练中被丢弃的检查点作为免费的教师池，通过有选择性的在线策略蒸馏来恢复最佳验证检查点所遗忘的智能体问题求解能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Agentic-OPD, which treats discarded GRPO training checkpoints as a cost-free teacher pool and selectively distills from them via on-policy distillation to recover problem-solving capabilities forgotten by the best-validation checkpoint.
